prompt: Write the body (about 250 words) of a Texas personal injury petition by a car accident victim against an auto insurer, with the parts Parties, Facts, Negligence and Damages in plain text. Accident: sideswipe while changing lanes. Injury: back strain. Use the exact placeholders [PLAINTIFF_NAME], [LOSS_DATE], [CITY] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1143; do not mention it.)
text:
PARTIES

Plaintiff [PLAINTIFF_NAME] is an individual residing in Texas who was the driver and sole occupant of a passenger vehicle involved in the collision described below. Defendant is an automobile insurance company authorized to do business in the State of Texas, which issued the policy under which Plaintiff seeks benefits and against which this claim is brought.

FACTS

On [LOSS_DATE], Plaintiff was driving on a multi-lane public roadway in [CITY], Texas. Plaintiff signaled and began moving into the adjacent lane when a vehicle operated by a driver insured under Defendant's policy moved into the same space without signaling or checking whether the lane was clear. The vehicles sideswiped one another, and the force of the contact pushed Plaintiff's car against the lane divider. Plaintiff stopped at the roadside, exchanged information with the other driver, and reported the collision to Defendant. Plaintiff has since submitted claim documentation and requested payment under the applicable coverage. Defendant has not offered a payment that reflects the injuries Plaintiff sustained.

NEGLIGENCE

The insured driver owed a duty to other motorists to exercise ordinary care when changing lanes, including signaling intent, maintaining a proper lookout, and confirming that the movement could be made safely. The insured driver breached that duty by changing lanes into an occupied lane without adequate precaution, and that breach was a proximate cause of the collision and of Plaintiff's injuries. Defendant, as the insurer responsible for the insured driver's liability, is answerable for the resulting harm to the extent provided by the policy and Texas law.

DAMAGES

As a direct result of the collision, Plaintiff suffered a back strain that caused pain, stiffness, and limited movement. Plaintiff has incurred medical expenses for examination and treatment, has lost time from work and daily activities, and continues to experience discomfort. Plaintiff seeks recovery of economic and non-economic damages in the amount of [DEMAND_AMOUNT], together with pre-judgment and post-judgment interest, court costs, and such other relief as the Court deems just.
